programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective suffers a fatal accident involving a mysterious medallion and is transformed into an immortal warrior with superhuman powers.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow leaves for the big city to try and save his home by winning the huge snooker tournament.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter-the sole witness-mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master, he fights to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father is exposed.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: The planned reburial of a town elder goes awry as the corpse resurrects into a hopping, bloodthirsty vampire, targeting everyone responsible for digging the grave. A Taoist Priest and his two disciples attempt to stop the terror.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh joins the carefree Spinsters’ Club when she discovers her husband is having an affair. Despite the seemingly happy front that her sisters put on, beneath it all, each of them secretly yearns for a man in her life.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: A frustrated young man afflicted with polio works as a paralegal for a corrupt lawyer. He gets passed onto him the technique for a strange power by a dying man, which turns him into an oil based superhero/villain.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Exploring The Unknown With Wang Yibo S2 - Eps. 5 The Path Of Pioneers
programme.desc: Wang Yibo dan Ryder Stroud tiba di Wyoming, menikmati budaya koboi Jackson Hole sebelum bertemu kembali dengan Jimmy Chin untuk tantangan panjat tebing baru.

programme.title: Exploring The Unknown With Wang Yibo S2 - Eps. 6 Straight To The Summit
programme.desc: Wang Yibo menaklukkan tebing besar Yosemite, Liberty Cap. Setelah tiga hari yang melelahkan melewati medan yang kompleks dan lecet di sekujur tubuhnya, ia akhirnya mencapai puncak berkat tekad yang kuat.

programme.title: Body Cam S6 - Eps. 5 Risking It All
programme.desc: Di New Mexico, pengejaran mobil berakhir dengan konsekuensi yang berkepanjangan bagi seorang letnan, dan seorang petugas sendirian harus tetap tenang untuk menahan tersangka pembunuhan dengan aman.

programme.title: Street Outlaws: No Prep Kings: The Great Eight_S2 S2 - Eps. 7 Gasping For Air
programme.desc: Di Idaho, Kye masih memimpin di babak Great 8. Tiga pembalap yang berada di posisi kedua berusaha mengejar sebelum ia unggul terlalu jauh.

programme.title: Conspiracies And Coverups S1 - Eps. 6 Mysterious Death Of Jeffrey Epstein
programme.desc: Andrew melakukan investigasi skala penuh atas kematian Epstein, merekonstruksi TKP saat ia mencari bukti bunuh diri, pembunuhan, atau sesuatu yang lebih gelap.

programme.title: Superbook
programme.desc: Animasi Religi Kristen Yang Menceritakan Petualangan Seru Chris Dan Joy, Bersama Robot Mereka Gizmo. programme.title: Beyblade X S2
programme.desc: Tim Persona Yang Kembali Berjuang Menaklukkan X Tower, Di Tengah Guncangan Besar Dunia Beyblade Pasca-Pertarungan Sengit Melawan Ryugu Kuromu.

programme.title: Beyblade X S3
programme.desc: Beyblade X Mengikuti Ancaman Baru Dari Zero Cross (Zero Kurasu) Dan Keluarganya Yang Berencana Membangun X Tower Baru Demi Sistem Beyblade Tandingan Dan Menghancurkan Menara Lama. Team Persona Harus Berjuang Melindungi X Tower Asli Dengan Menghadapi Anak-Anak Zero.

programme.title: Gavan Infinity
programme.desc: Menceritakan Kisah Reiji Doki, Penyelidik Polisi Federal Galaksi, Yang Mengemban Gelar Space Sheriff Gavan. Ia Menyelidiki Emorgear Energi Kehidupan Yang Bereaksi Terhadap Emosi Negatif Guna Menghentikan Ancaman Kriminal Lintas Dimensi Yang Dapat Meruntuhkan

programme.title: Adu Kelas

Program Ini Akan Menampilkan Praktik Sains Dari Kakak Ilmuwan, Pertunjukan Dongeng, Hingga Pertunjukan Bakat Siswa Seperti Menyanyi, Menari, Berolahraga, Dll. Pada Setiap Bagian Program Terdapat Pembelajaran Bagi Siswa Yang Dikemas Lebih Menyenangkan.

Para Smurf Tinggal Di Rumah Berbentuk Jamur Dan Hidup Dengan Damai. Namun, Kedatangan Penyihir Jahat Gargamel Dan Kucingnya, Azrael, Merusak Kedamaian Desa Tersebut. programme.title: Boboiboy Galaxy

programme.title: Papa Pipi

programme.title: Haikyu!! The Movie: The Talent And The Sense
programme.desc: Tim Voli Sma Karasuno Mempersiapkan Diri Untuk Turnamen Spring High Dengan Mengikuti Latihan Gabungan Bersama Tim-Tim Kuat Dari Wilayah Kanto. Dengan Berbagai Peningkatan, Mereka Berhasil Mencapai Semifinal Turnamen Spring High. Lawan Mereka Adalah Sma Aoba Johsai, Yang Sebelumnya Mengalahkan Mereka Di Kualifikasi Inter-High. Karasuno Memulai Pertandingan Dengan Serangan Agresif, Tetapi Perlahan Alur Permainan Beralih Ke Aoba Johsai Berkat Servis Akurat Oikawa Dan Spike Keras Dari Senjata Rahasia Mereka, Kyoutani. Untuk Membalikkan Keadaan, Hinata Dan Kageyama Mengandalkan Quick Attack Mereka Yang Telah Berkembang, Serta Servis Ace Dari Yamaguchi. Akankah Mereka Berhasil Mengalahkan Lawan Yang Penuh Rivalitas Ini?
